card.name: Small words after eliminate or excrete verbs
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, in, by, into, via) right after a verb or phrase about elimination, excretion, removal or disposal. Seen in drug-label text on how a drug leaves the body or how waste is thrown out.

modes.label: Route of excretion
modes.description: The word 'the' or a preposition follows 'eliminated by', 'excreted into' or 'via' before an organ such as kidneys or bile.
modes.example: Cefprozil is eliminated primarily by<< the>> kidneys.

modes.label: Disposal instructions
modes.description: A linking word follows 'throw out' or 'dispose in' before trash or waste.
modes.example: throw out the container in<< the>> trash (advise patients not to flush

modes.label: Removal by procedure
modes.description: 'by' follows 'removed from the circulation' before dialysis.
modes.example: While captopril may be removed from the adult circulation<< by>> hemodialysis, there is inadequate data

card.writes: It lowers the odds of removal words coming next, since the removal idea has already been stated. It favors the noun that completes the phrase.
card.plain: It fires on the little word after 'eliminated by' or 'excreted in', just before the organ or trash is named.
